about: The app's sounds (Phase 1 D4; FR-SET-004, NFR-PERF-005; ADR-0027). scripts/sound/build.mjs builds every entry: a UI sound from its soundcraft-cli script (saved as <id>.scraft, bounced with file.bounce_mix from 0 to `seconds`), a loop from its source file. Each is folded to mono, scaled to a -1 dBFS sample peak and encoded as mono AAC with ffmpeg. `tools` names the builds the committed files came from: --check compares bytes, which only holds on the same SoundCraft and ffmpeg.

sounds.use: A focus session completes: plays with the sticker placement.

loops.use: Fly Mode's ambient loop (useFlyModeAudio, loaded lazily with Fly). The source's leading silence and fade-in are trimmed and its tail is crossfaded into its head, so it wraps without a gap (the owner chose this over a faithful re-encode, 2026-10-30). Both lengths are whole AAC frames (1024 samples), which keeps the loop frame-aligned.

babble.about: Pomo & Doro's babble for the tutorial (Phase 1 D5; FR-ONB-001, FR-SET-004, NFR-PERF-005; ADR-0027): a few syllables per character, each synthesised from its script in art/sound/babble/ (written by scripts/sound/babble-scripts.mjs), bounced, folded to mono and encoded like the UI sounds. Unlike them, they are level-matched by loudness, not peak: each syllable to one loudness, then each voice so that a sample line written on at the tutorial's pace (art/src/tour/expressions.json, motion.talk) reaches `level.streamMomentaryLufs` on the same EBU R 128 momentary meter as the UI sounds, a little below them (version 2, after the owner asked for softer voices: −20 LUFS, about 6 LU under them). A `role` of up or down marks the line-end syllable for a question or a statement; `mouth` is the tour kit's mouth layer that shows while the syllable sounds.

playback.about: Applied when each syllable plays, never baked into the files (the owner's sound-design notes, 2026-11-01): a random pitch shift uniform in ±detuneCents and a random gain uniform in ±gainDb, drawn afresh for every syllable, so a line never sounds like a loop. The files stay exactly as built.

lines.pomo: Hi! We're Pomo and Doro, and we'll show you around the diary.
lines.doro: Every focus you finish puts a sticker on today's page. Shall we look?
